title: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.39714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. translated_title: MoLRSI：一种用于分子发现的递归自我改进AI智能体
translated_abstract: 分子发现需要在广阔的组合搜索空间中进行导航，同时平衡相互竞争的生物学目标。AI智能体可以自动化专家定义的分子设计方案，但仅靠自动化并不能解决如何针对新任务优化工作流程、或如何通过经验改进其开发的问题。本文介绍了MoLRSI，这是一种AI智能体，它将工作流程与模型架构的系统优化相结合，并利用持久的跨任务记忆来递归地改进其分子发现搜索策略。工作流程性能、优化结果和执行反馈会指导后续搜索，使智能体既能改进其工作流程，也能改进其开发工作流程的策略。我们在两个需要平衡相互竞争属性的、具有挑战性的分子发现场景中对MoLRSI进行了评估。在抗生素发现任务中，MoLRSI开发出了一个兼顾抗菌活性、细胞毒性和结构新颖性的筛选工作流程。
tldr: MoLRSI是一种结合工作流程系统优化与跨任务持久记忆的AI智能体，能够通过递归自我改进不断提升分子发现的搜索策略，并在抗生素发现等任务中成功平衡多种相互竞争的分子属性。
